videos.t: Hydrolyze Acetylsalicylic Acid into Salicylic Acid
videos.desc:
Join the science discord! https://discord.gg/pw5sZ3PTye Please read the entire description!

50gm ASA
33.5gm NaOH
150ml water
Filter
Add conc. HCl to taste (~150ml)
Filter
Wash, rinse & repeat.
Dry

2 things
1.) You don't need to separate the ASA from tablets.
2.) Stir NaOH slowly!



(a) CH3COO-C6H4-COOH + NaOH → CH3COO-C6H4-COONa + H2O

(b) CH3COO-C6H4-COONa + NaOH → HO-C6H4-COONa + CH3COONa

(c) HO-C6H4-COONa + NaOH → NaO-C6H4-COONa + H2O

(d) NaO-C6H4-COONa + 2 HCl → HO-C6H4-COOH + 2 NaCl
